name: Svinoriz 10 Opto
about: The BOOTSTRAP component spec (DRN-03; p6-flight-core design 3, task 1.3): docs/knowledge.md §5.2's assumed layout (from reference-notes/wind.md §5.5) at its nominal in-flight loadout, 4.8 kg with the coil half paid out and 1 kg of payload aboard. p5-drone task 1.2 replaced the repository's drone.json with letter T's researched layout (D-043), and this file became a test fixture, so the K§5.2 cross-check and the rigid-body tests still run on it; its legs_off block is the bootstrap's own rule, the legs alone off. K§5.2 writes its layout with x forward and z up; this file is in the body frame of DetMath.cs: x right, y up, z forward, metres from the arm-plane centre. Positions are data: nothing in the code knows where a part sits. Every number is labelled where it stands (pilot, measured, published, derived or assumed) and the note gives its source or its calculation.

fields.labelled number: {"value": <number, or [x, y, z], or a list>, "label": "pilot" | "measured" | "published" | "derived" | "assumed", "note": "<source or calculation>"}; the note is optional, the label is not
fields.bootstrap: true for p6-flight-core's stand-in; p5-drone's researched file sets false
fields.parts: every rigid part the mass build sums (PHB-02): name (unique), kind (box | cylinder), material (carbon | aluminium | steel | polymer | li_ion | electronics), mass_kg (above 0), position_m (the part's centre); a box has size_m, its extents along body x, y, z; a cylinder is solid, with diameter_m, length_m and axis (the direction of its length, normalised when read)
fields.motors: four, in Betaflight's Quad X order (rear right, front right, rear left, front left): position_m (the prop hub, where the thrust acts), spin (cw | ccw seen from above; cw is a positive rotation about body +y), kv_rpm_per_v, resistance_ohm (the DC model's resistance: winding, ESC and leads), no_load_current_a (the bearings' and iron's loss, as the torque Kt·I0), rotor_inertia_kg_m2 (bell, shaft and prop about the shaft), magnet_poles, esc_tau_s (the ESC's command filter), esc_current_limit_a (the ESC's current limit: the motor's current never passes it while the ESC drives); the motor's lag τ_m = J/(Kt·Ke/R + ∂Q/∂ω) follows from these and the load
fields.props: the four props, alike: diameter_m, blades, pitch_m (geometric, per revolution), k_t_n_per_rad2_s2 (T = k_T·n², n in rad/s) and kappa_m (Q = κ·T), both static at reference_rpm (one of static_rpm's points); static_rpm with static_thrust_ratio and static_torque_ratio (C_T and C_P there over their values at reference_rpm: the coefficients' change with rpm); inflow_advance_ratio (J = V_a/(n·D) of the axial inflow, from 0) with inflow_thrust_ratio and inflow_torque_ratio (C_T and C_P there over their static values); linear between points, held at the ends; h_force_n_per_m_s (the rotor's in-plane drag, the H-force, per m/s of its hub's in-plane airspeed at reference_rpm, growing in proportion to the rotor's speed)
fields.packs: two (PHB-03): part (the pack's mass part), series and parallel cells, cell_capacity_ah, r_cell_ohm, ocv_v (one cell's open-circuit voltage at states of charge 0, 1/(n−1), …, 1)
fields.legs: parts (the four leg parts, in Betaflight's corner order; a leg's length is its part's, its foot the part's lower end), stiffness_n_per_m and damping_n_s_per_m (each leg's own spring and damper, in series with the ground), foot_radius_m; legs off is legs_off's build
fields.legs_off: the legs-off build: removed (every part that comes off with the legs, the four leg parts among them), moved ({part name: its labelled centre on the legs-off build})
fields.coil: part (the spool's mass part, whose mass falls as the line pays out), spool_mass_kg (empty, with its housing), fiber_mass_kg and fiber_length_m (the line on a full spool); the part's mass here is this file's loadout
fields.payload: part (the payload's mass part, set to the pilot's payload), mass_min_kg and mass_max_kg (the setting's range, APP-03); the part is the body at its mass here, this file's loadout, and another payload scales it by the cube root of the mass ratio, growing away from the arm plane
fields.stand: the legs-off launch stand (D-022, D-043): material, post_radius_m (each post on a motor diagonal, from the stand's centre), post_height_m (the post tops above the ground), post_diameter_m, mass_kg
fields.aero: the airframe's drag (p6-flight-core 1.5): air_density_kg_m3; body_area_m2 (the silhouette less the coil's, projected along body x, y and z: side, top, front); body_center_of_pressure_m (where the body's drag acts); drag_coefficient (of the body's silhouette and of the coil, whose own drag acts at the coil part's centre with its cylinder's silhouette)
